system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: project-info
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:projects.get
  properties:
    projectId: $(project)

- name: gha-deployer-sa
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
  properties:
    name: projects/$(project)
    accountId: gha-deployer
    serviceAccount:
      displayName: GitHub Actions Deployer SA
      description: Service account impersonated via Workload Identity Federation by GitHub Actions

- name: cloud-run-runtime-sa
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
  properties:
    name: projects/$(project)
    accountId: cloud-run-runtime
    serviceAccount:
      displayName: Cloud Run Runtime SA
      description: Runtime identity for Cloud Run services

- name: wif-pool
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(ref.project-info.projectNumber)/locations/global
    workloadIdentityPoolId: github-pool
    workloadIdentityPool:
      displayName: GitHub Actions Pool
      description: Workload Identity Pool for GitHub Actions OIDC
      disabled: false

- name: wif-provider-github
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools.providers
  properties:
    parent: $(ref.wif-pool.name)
    workloadIdentityPoolProviderId: github
    workloadIdentityPoolProvider:
      displayName: GitHub OIDC Provider
      description: OIDC provider for GitHub Actions
      disabled: false
      oidc:
        issuerUri: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
        allowedAudiences:
        - sts.googleapis.com
      attributeMapping:
        google.subject: assertion.sub
        attribute.repository: assertion.repository
        attribute.ref: assertion.ref
        attribute.actor: assertion.actor
        attribute.workflow: assertion.workflow
      attributeCondition: assertion.repository == 'your-org/your-repo' && assertion.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && assertion.aud == 'sts.googleapis.com'

- name: wif-binding-sa-impersonation
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: projects/$(project)/serviceAccounts/$(ref.gha-deployer-sa.email)
    role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
    member: principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/$(ref.wif-pool.name)/attribute.repository/your-org/your-repo
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - wif-provider-github
    - gha-deployer-sa

- name: project-bind-run-admin
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/run.admin
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.gha-deployer-sa.email)

- name: runtime-sa-allow-actAs
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: projects/$(project)/serviceAccounts/$(ref.cloud-run-runtime-sa.email)
    role: roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.gha-deployer-sa.email)

- name: project-bind-ar-reader-runtime
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/artifactregistry.reader
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.cloud-run-runtime-sa.email)
